stories.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
stories.take: Uber is taking ChatGPT Work company-wide to all 30,000 employees after a smaller pilot — enterprise agents go mainstream at ride-share scale.

stories.title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
stories.take: Anthropic's new Claude Duet app, waitlisted for Pro and Max users, is its bet that agents — not just chat — are the product.

stories.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
stories.take: DeepSeek reportedly raised $15 billion, one of China's largest rounds, days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its tech over security concerns.

stories.title: Tesla is prepping a Cybercab onslaught
stories.take: Tesla is prepping a Cybercab rollout to more US cities this year, while going quiet on how many paid robotaxi rides it has actually run.

stories.title: Tesla profits drop 43% in Q3
stories.take: Tesla profits fell 43% in Q3 and its energy storage business shrank — even as spending on Optimus, AI and autonomy surged.

stories.title: 333 Tor exit nodes hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and retrieve plaintext email
stories.take: For three days, 333 Tor exit nodes were hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and retrieve plaintext email — a rare, targeted attack on the anonymity network.

stories.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched
stories.take: AWS logged exploitation attempts for the PHP2Shell bugs four days before patches — the flaws are now being broadly exploited across the internet.

stories.title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
stories.take: Hugging Face's new open-source biology model speaks the language of DNA and aims to help researchers predict how gene changes affect activity and health.

stories.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
stories.take: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raised $1 billion at a $6 billion valuation to build models 'without ingesting half the internet.'

stories.title: OpenAI's latest AI models are coming to Google Cloud and Antigravity
stories.take: OpenAI's latest models — GPT 6.1 Astra, Sol and Luna — are coming to Google Cloud and Antigravity in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Apple Music's splashy new logo is gorgeous – so why isn't the new app icon?
stories.take: Apple Music revealed a splashy new visual identity months in the making — gorgeous logo, but Creative Bloq asks why the app icon does not match it.

stories.title: Meta’s Ad Sales Are Suffering Now That Europeans Can Pick Less Personalization
stories.take: Meta told investors ad revenue has slowed since the EU's Less-Personalized Ads model began — privacy choice is now a measurable ad headwind.

stories.title: How AB InBev built a culture of creative effectiveness that drives growth
stories.take: At ANA Masters of Marketing, AB InBev's global CMO explained the shift from advertiser to provider of experiences — creative effectiveness as a culture, not a campaign.

stories.title: Marcel Gets its First CEO as Publicis Competes With Off-the-Shelf AI
stories.take: Publicis named the first CEO and CSO for Marcel, its AI platform that started as an employee tool and now builds agents for more than 90 clients.

stories.title: Walmart Connect pitches brands directly as it pushes lift studies ahead of holiday ad deals
stories.take: Walmart Connect is pitching brands directly with lift studies ahead of holiday deals — a tighter race with Amazon for retail media budgets.

stories.title: Target’s holiday push stresses affordability, exclusives and an AI assistant
stories.take: Target's holiday push leads with affordability and exclusives, plus a new AI assistant, Ask Target, on its site and app.

stories.title: Banana Republic debuts TikTok content series in bid for younger shoppers
stories.take: Banana Republic launched a TikTok content series to chase younger shoppers, as Gap Inc. leans harder into entertainment marketing.

stories.title: Netflix lowers ad revenue forecast by 10%, continues to beef up ad suite
stories.take: Netflix cut its ad revenue forecast by 10% — about $300 million — even as Q3 revenue grew 12% and its ad suite keeps expanding.

stories.title: Emotional Haliburton leads Pacers' gritty win in long-awaited return from Achilles tear
stories.take: An emotional Tyrese Haliburton returned from the Achilles tear he suffered in Game 7 of the 2025 Finals and led Indiana to a gritty opening win over New Orleans.

stories.title: Clippers dedicate opening win over Kings to banned Ballmer
stories.take: The Clippers routed Sacramento 121-96 and dedicated the opening win to suspended owner Steve Ballmer: 'We're still fighting for him.'

stories.title: Luka: Lakers' 'ceiling is even higher,' pairs with Kessler for blowout
stories.take: Luka Doncic, installed as the Lakers' new face, paired with Walker Kessler in a 127-105 blowout of Golden State and said the ceiling is 'even higher.'

stories.title: Wolves' Edwards joins Wilt, MJ after dropping 40 in another opener
stories.take: Anthony Edwards scored 40 in another opener, joining Wilt Chamberlain and Michael Jordan as the only players with multiple 40-point season openers.

stories.title: Lillard gets enthusiastic welcome in first game back with Trail Blazers
stories.take: Damian Lillard got an enthusiastic welcome in his first game back with Portland, scoring 25 with six 3s in a rout of Phoenix.

stories.title: Giannis says new-look Heat 'got to trust each other more' after blowout loss
stories.take: Giannis, now with Miami, preached trust after a blowout opening loss to Minnesota — his new-look Heat have work to do.

stories.title: The tortoise and the Thunder: How patience made Shai Gilgeous-Alexander an MVP
stories.take: How patience built the partnership between two-time MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and GM Sam Presti that fueled Oklahoma City's rise.

stories.title: Victor Wembanyama on his dismal opening night performance vs. OKC: 'This is not the sport I like right here'
stories.take: Victor Wembanyama went 1-for-13 against OKC and said it himself: 'This is not the sport I like right here.'

stories.title: 2026 World Series odds, prediction: Full Fall Classic preview for Brewers vs. Rays starting Friday, Oct. 23
stories.take: Full Fall Classic preview: Brewers vs. Rays starts Friday, Oct. 23 — just the sixth World Series between No. 1 seeds in the Wild Card Era.

stories.title: Wait till this year! Just how rare a World Series between teams that have never won really is
stories.take: A first-time champion is guaranteed: neither Milwaukee nor Tampa Bay has ever won a World Series — a rarity ESPN puts in historical context.

stories.title: Rasmussen or Miz? Caminero or Chourio? Ranking every player in the 2026 World Series
stories.take: Rasmussen or Misiorowski? Caminero or Chourio? ESPN ranks every player in the Brewers-Rays World Series.

stories.title: Three reasons why the Rays can finally win their first World Series title
stories.take: Three reasons Tampa Bay — the AL's best team all year — can finally win its first title in its third World Series trip.

stories.title: Ohtani won't require surgery; Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year'
stories.take: Shohei Ohtani will not need surgery, and the Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year,' president Andrew Friedman said.

stories.title: MLB Lockout 101: In-depth guide to likely work stoppage and what it means for free agency, 2027 season, more
stories.take: MLB Lockout 101: why a work stoppage looks near-certain, when it would start, and what it means for free agency and the 2027 season.

stories.title: Suzuki out as Angels manager; interim GM Mozeliak won't return in 2027
stories.take: Kurt Suzuki is out as Angels manager after one season and the franchise's first 100-loss year — MLB's third managerial vacancy.

stories.title: Russia bombards Kyiv with missiles hours after agreeing to resume talks with Ukraine
stories.take: Russia bombarded Kyiv with missiles hours after agreeing to resume talks with Ukraine — experts say the target is energy infrastructure before winter.

stories.title: Iran threatens oil and AI facilities across seven Gulf countries if US and Israel renew attacks
stories.take: Iran threatened 'zero red lines' — oil facilities, undersea cables, data centers and AI facilities across seven Gulf countries — if the US and Israel attack again.

stories.title: Pete Hegseth has reportedly given DHS permission to test ‘heat ray’ for use at US-Mexico border
stories.take: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reportedly gave DHS permission to test the Pentagon's 'heat ray' Active Denial System for use at the US-Mexico border.

stories.title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
stories.take: Trump's push for mid-decade redistricting gave Republicans a head start on holding the House — now voters decide whether it works.

stories.title: How tech became the villain of the US midterms
stories.take: Data centers, AI and distaste for the billionaires building them have soured Americans on big tech — tech is now a midterm villain.

stories.title: Too little, too late: Trump takes on gas prices as fuel costs hamper his midterm hopes
stories.take: Polls show voters deeply upset by high gas prices and ready to punish Republicans — Trump is taking on fuel costs late, with midterms near.

stories.title: Experts alarmed by ‘less transparent’ CDC as US measles deaths rise
stories.take: The CDC added a third US measles death but declined to say which state it occurred in — experts are alarmed by a 'less transparent' agency.

stories.title: Supreme court blocks Trump’s bid to restrict gender care for trans prisoners
stories.take: The Supreme Court blocked Trump's bid to restrict gender care for trans prisoners — a break from its recent pattern of siding with the administration.

stories.title: A company says its polls were fake. Here's what happened
stories.take: A national polling firm revealed most of its data was fabricated — an 'experimental project' to expose how vulnerable modern polling is.

stories.title: Investigation finds hundreds of U.S. citizens detained by ICE
stories.take: An investigation found hundreds of US citizens detained by ICE; California officials are calling for a probe after a citizen was allegedly injured and detained.

stories.title: California cities pull the plug on data centers after state regulations don’t scale up fast enough
stories.take: California cities are pulling the plug locally: at least 26 moratoriums, bans or resolutions on data centers since June, despite seven new state laws.

stories.title: Why the fate of California’s wealth tax could be decided well after the election
stories.take: Proposition 40, the California wealth tax, faces poison-pill propositions and a likely court fight — its fate may be decided well after the election.

stories.title: Twenty years after California's landmark climate law, the state is not on track to meet its targets
stories.take: Twenty years after its landmark climate law, California is only about halfway to its 2030 greenhouse-gas goal, per the state's own inventory.

stories.title: Medi-Cal cuts could push seniors and people with disabilities off of coverage
stories.take: New Medi-Cal asset limits are forcing low-income seniors and people with disabilities to draw down savings to keep their health coverage.

stories.title: Thousands of California state workers walk off the job in contract dispute with Newsom
stories.take: Thousands of California state workers walked off the job in a one-day strike, pressing Gov. Newsom for raises and more work-from-home flexibility.

stories.title: Rain triggers flooding, erosion concerns across SoCal. Could it stomp out fire season?
stories.take: Rain across Southern California is triggering flooding and erosion concerns — but experts say it will not end fire season yet.

stories.title: Preschool, transitional kindergarten deliver big: 11 months ahead in reading, 8 in math
stories.take: California's transitional kindergarten expansion is paying off: kids scored 11 months ahead in reading and 8 in math by third and fourth grade.

stories.title: Hiltzik: The Arizona-Nevada-California water war is heating up, and all three states will end up parched
stories.take: Hiltzik: Arizona and Nevada are asserting Colorado River rights, but there simply is not enough water — all three states could end up parched.

stories.title: Bill Gates says to prepare for 20 years of ‘tumultuous’ AI disruption
stories.take: Gates calls AI 'the most dangerous technology ever invented' but is not a doomer: expect ~20 years of tumultuous disruption that could split society between those at the frontier and those who reject it • Biggest near-term risks are bad actors using unsafeguarded models for cyberattacks and bioterrorism, plus white-collar job disruption first • His fix: mandatory government safety standards and an external 'police layer' — deterministic rules a frontier agent cannot break — not voluntary self-governance

stories.title: The Election That Will Define Israel’s Future
stories.take: Israel's first election since Oct. 7 pits Netanyahu's right-wing/religious bloc against Gadi Eisenkot's opposition, each with roughly half the electorate • Both blocs agree a Palestinian state is not on the table — the race turns on accountability for Oct. 7, a national inquiry Netanyahu refuses, and 'sharing the burden' on the ultra-Orthodox draft • Eisenkot, who lost a son and two nephews in Gaza, quit the war cabinet in June 2024 over hostage-deal disagreements

stories.title: Democratic Surrogates Campaign, US & Israel Plan Iran Strikes, Tesla SpaceX Merger
stories.take: Democrats fan out surrogates — Obama to Ohio/Michigan/Georgia, Harris to Mississippi, Sanders to Maine/Florida/Texas — in a shadow 2028 primary as Black early turnout surges • A source tells NPR the US is amassing forces for a possible Iran strike by early November, after the midterms and Israeli elections • Musk confirmed Tesla and SpaceX are exploring a merger: 'Do I think it would be a good idea? Yes'

stories.title: Can Meta Turn Muse’s Popularity Into Profits?
stories.take: The answer: not yet — Muse is popular for shopping (over 25% of users, average purchase over $200) but unprofitable on high compute costs • Meta plans to monetize by taking a cut of e-commerce transactions, not ads, which could add billions • Hurdles: Amazon has blocked Muse, and CFO Susan Lee says profitability will take time — 'not a total home run'

stories.title: Why Elon Might Merge Tesla And SpaceX
stories.take: The answer: Tesla would get SpaceX compute, AI and chips for robotaxi/Optimus, Starlink's cash engine (billions per quarter) to fund capex, shared execution culture, and a talent magnet • But a merger does NOT solve Tesla's ground game — robotaxi charging, cleaning, utilization and regulation • Tesla Q3: revenue flat, $1.5B free cash flow beat, auto margins up 200 bps; Meta Q3 revenue +26% with capex guided at $135–145B

stories.title: Bhaskar Sunkara Thinks the Market Has a Place Under Socialism
stories.take: Sunkara's market socialism: worker-owned cooperatives for consumer goods, an expansive public sector, and public banking to allocate credit — markets kept for choice and information • Workers become residual claimants who elect management, with benchmark wages and hard budget constraints so firms can still fail • Housing: all land publicly owned (Singapore model) with market rents, secure tenure and phased rent increases

stories.title: Can a "moneyball" system work for campaign funding?
stories.take: The answer: yes, at the margins — Oath's impact scores steer donors to down-ballot races like Georgia state Senate candidate Darcy Castro (score 10) instead of saturated races like Texas Senate candidate James Tallarico (score 1.6) • Oath processes ~$1M in donations daily and donors say funded races got closer or flipped • It cannot fix dark money and billionaire spending — Bloomberg $80M, Musk hundreds of millions

stories.title: What "You Can See Everything" Is Really About, with Wesley Morris
stories.take: The answer: the Fielder/Oppenheim film about Elizabeth Holmes is really about the illusion of total access and the human need to be understood • It destabilizes truth — truth depends on what the lie or truth serves — and denies journalistic closure on purpose • Wesley Morris reads even a horse-fart scene as a deliberate puncture of journalistic pretension; Seyfried's final line: 'It's very complicated'

stories.title: US and European websites go offline over security concerns
stories.take: AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities — in tech used by over two-thirds of websites — forced governments and sites like the BBC and Wikipedia offline for emergency patching; Wiz called them the most severe ever found by AI • Witkoff met Putin and the Kremlin freed 74-year-old American Stephen Hubbard, with possible three-way talks in November • Airbnb's Nov. 20 rule bars hosts from asking guests to do dishes, laundry or strip beds

stories.title: Thunderstorm peaks, Family of shot TikToker to sue feds, Lakers debut of "Milk" Chamberlain— Morning Edition
stories.take: Flood watch for the Santa Monica Mountains and Malibu coast, with the week's heaviest rain today • The family of a TikToker shot by ICE agents plans to sue the feds; his son says his arm was left disfigured and barely movable • Lakers beat Golden State 127–105: Doncic 28, and new center Walker Kessler 26 on perfect 12-for-12 shooting — best perfect game since Wilt Chamberlain in 1969

stories.title: EA Shuts Down BioWare - Kinda Funny Games Daily 10.21.26
stories.take: EA is shutting down BioWare outright and cutting ~400 jobs, including ~50 at BioWare; the next Mass Effect is canceled • Context: EA went private in a $55B leveraged buyout that loaded ~$18B in debt, and it had promised investors up to $700M in savings partly from R&D cuts • Hosts' bottom line: the debt-driven new EA is choosing sports and live service over storied single-player RPGs — support the smaller studios now carrying the torch

stories.title: Triple Play: Control Resonant
stories.take: Remedy's Control Resonant shifts from shooter to melee character-action: Dylan Faden, a shape-shifting weapon, open-world Manhattan and the Oldest House 7 years on • Kirk Hamilton (finished, ~30 hrs) calls it a 'baller ass video game' and Maddy Myers (~20 hrs) loves the combat flow • Jason Schreier bounced after a few hours — melee felt 'mashy' with spongy enemies

stories.title: Ukraine comes under renewed Russian attack
stories.take: Russia launched three waves of ballistic missiles on Kyiv — 21 missiles, 2 killed and 30+ wounded in the capital, 7 more deaths elsewhere — hours after signaling readiness to resume peace talks; Zelensky called it a 'demonstrative strike' • Ukraine fired hundreds of drones at Moscow in reply • Also: the leaked PHP flaw triggered mass automated scanning (scans are not breaches), and NYT reports plans for possible US/Israel strikes on Iran after the Nov. 3 midterms
